data.body: Fixed: COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Step 2 now unions 'git diff HEAD --name-only' with 'git diff --cached --name-only' (piped through sort -u) so newly staged files with no HEAD history are included in the file list passed to skip-review-check.sh. Also updated the usage comment in skip-review-check.sh to document the correct invocation pattern. Added test 'test_commit_workflow_uses_cached_diff_for_new_files' to prevent regression.
